Aligned Panel Review

Use the threshold sliders to inspect complete-linkage agglomerative clustering on the aligned panel and tree-distance clustering from the neighbor-joining tree. Toggle between alignment-based PCoA, alignment-based UMAP, AF UMAP, best-vs-second-best reference identity, and tree views.

Exports the active clustering scheme at the current threshold.

Agreement compares every precomputed AF/Leiden state against every distance-derived clustering state on sampled genomes only. Higher NMI indicates greater information overlap between partitions.
